trigger_definition: CREATE TRIGGER metrics_daily_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.metrics_daily FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()
CREATE TRIGGER meta_connections_pagina_compartilhada BEFORE UPDATE OF meta_page_id ON public.meta_connections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION impedir_troca_pagina_compartilhada()
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.impedir_troca_pagina_compartilhada()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.meta_page_id is distinct from old.meta_page_id
      and (select count(*) from public.ad_accounts
           where business_id = new.business_id and is_active = true) > 1 then
    raise exception 'pagina compartilhada entre contas';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$
